title: Estatístico
description:
QUEM SOMOS:

A Marketdata&Match é a união de duas líderes em Customer Experience e Marketing Automation, formando uma das maiores potências do setor na América Latina.

Atuamos com excelência em dados, tecnologia e marketing, implementando e operando plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Unimos inteligência analítica, personalização e performance para impulsionar estratégias de CRM e Customer Experience.

Integramos uma equipe multidisciplinar e uma metodologia orientada a resultados, entregando soluções que fortalecem o relacionamento entre marcas e consumidores e promovem experiências relevantes, mensuráveis e escaláveis.

Somos reconhecidos como Parceira do Ano no ecossistema Salesforce, e integramos o maior hub de Martech e CX da América Latina, entregando excelência em toda a jornada de consumo.

Descrição das atividades:

Imersão no negócio dos clientes para transformar dados em decisões estratégicas: construir análises acionáveis, recomendar desdobramentos em ações de marketing e aprofundar diagnósticos com modelagem preditiva e estudos investigativos.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar imersão no contexto de cada cliente, entender objetivos de negócio e definir hipóteses, métricas e KPIs.
  • Extrair, integrar e preparar dados (principalmente via SQL) para análises descritivas, diagnósticas e preditivas.
  • Construir e validar modelos preditivos (ex.: propensão, churn, segmentação, LTV) e estudos investigativos orientados a hipóteses.
  • Traduzir insights em recomendações práticas e planos de ação de marketing, com estimativa de impacto e priorização.
  • Elaborar apresentações claras (PowerPoint) e conduzir storytelling com dados para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Garantir qualidade, reprodutibilidade e governança das análises (documentação, versionamento, boas práticas).
  • Acompanhar resultados, medir impacto (ex.: testes A/B) e iterar com foco em melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e competências

  • R ou Python para análise e modelagem de dados.
  • SQL para consulta e manipulação em banco de dados.
  • Pacote Office: Excel, PowerPoint e Word.
  • Fundamentos sólidos de estatística e modelagem (regressão, classificação, validação de modelos).
  • Experiência em projetos que conectem analytics a decisões de marketing/negócio.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara, organização e pensamento crítico orientado a resultados.
  • Graduação em Estatística.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Progress Rail’s Uptime team is seeking a talented AI/ML to drive innovation and deliver impactful business solutions through advanced analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. This role focuses on solving complex business challenges across domains ranging from operations and customer experience to strategic decision-making by leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML technologies. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy intelligent systems that transform data into actionable insights. You’ll play a key role in shaping high-tech, scalable solutions that enhance business performance and customer value.

About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.

Key Job Elements

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy AI/ML-powered software systems and applications
  • Translate business problems into data-driven solutions using machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling
  • Apply NLP and LLMs (e.g., RAG architecture) for document summarization, search, and text analytics
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model validation
  • Deliver ad-hoc insights and present findings clearly to stakeholders
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and business teams to integrate models into production systems
  • Support issue resolution and decision-making through data analysis.
  • Ensure model scalability, reliability, and performance in real-world environments

Education Requirements

  • B.S, M.S, or PhD degree in quantitative discipline such as data science, data analytics, computer science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or other related degree.

Technical Skill

  • Experience in AI/ML, data science, or applied analytics
  • Expertise in data extraction, wrangling, modeling, and visualization across structured and unstructured datasets
  • Proven ability to build and deploy ML models for predictive and prescriptive analytics
  • Experience with NLP and LLMs for business applications (e.g., search, summarization, classification)
  • Strong statistical foundation: hypothesis testing, distributions, regression, etc.
  • Proficiency in Python (required); SQL and other languages are a plus

Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

description:
About Circulate

Circulate is a global creative marketing agency at the intersection of music, culture, and brand. We partner with world-leading artists, labels, and brands to tell stories that cut through noise and spark conversation. Our work spans strategy, content creation, digital marketing, and cultural moments that resonate worldwide.

The Role

We’re looking for a skilled Creative & Video Editor to join our fast-moving agency team. You’ll be part of the production/creative studio at Circulate, shaping the visuals that fuel campaigns for some of the biggest names in music and culture. This role is for someone who is hungry to learn, passionate about creative, skilled at video editing, and ready to bring energy and creativity to every project.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit short-form and long-form content for social, digital, and campaign platforms.
  • Work closely with producers, designers, and senior editors to deliver polished, on-brand videos.
  • Adapt content for multiple platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.), ensuring formats, aspect ratios, and specs are correct.

  • Keep a finger on the pulse of cultural and content trends, bringing fresh ideas and editing styles to projects.
  • Contribute creatively to brainstorms and campaign development.
  • Deliver projects to tight deadlines while maintaining high standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects, Photoshop, and DaVinci Resolve a plus).
  • A strong sense of timing, storytelling, and rhythm.
  • An understanding of editing for social-first platforms.
  • Attention to detail and an organised approach to file management.
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative team player who thrives under pressure.
  • A genuine interest in music, culture, and digital content.

What We Offer

  • The chance to work with global artists, brands, and cultural leaders.
  • A creative, supportive team environment that values ideas at every level.
  • Opportunities to grow your skills across editing, production, and creative storytelling.
  • Exposure to high-profile campaigns and international projects.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.

We are looking for a junior creative with creative flair and superb technical skills. If the above sounds like you, apply now. Be sure to add a link to your portfolio.

title: Business Development Representative Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Description

Your Career

Managing a Business Development team is not an easy task. This is the opportunity for those interested in being a part of something bigger than themselves. We are out to fulfill our company mission with the strongest products in the industry. Being a BD Manager means handling rejection well, but persevering, regardless. It means leading, cold-calling, selling, and pitching our products to people who are under tremendous pressure to secure their digital environments. And it means sticking with it with a level of tenacity defined only by your commitment to seeing a sale through.

To fit in this role, you are personable, collaborative, and a mentor who instills a learning environment and demonstrates a strong work ethic. You are confident in who you are and able to enjoy the personable interactions that come with a job in sales leadership. Becoming a part of the management team means you will be surrounded by amazing, smart and hardworking peers and that’s a great place to be.

Your Impact

  • You’ll lead a team that arguably has one of the toughest jobs in the building - The Business Development team is the glue between marketing and sales, responsible for carrying the baton from marketing lead to sales opportunity - The primary focus of this team is to consistently and efficiently meet a monthly quota of booking “Sales Qualified Opportunities” for the Account Reps

  • Oversee the daily activities and quota performance management of individual BDRs to ensure key performance metrics are met

  • Mentor new BDRs with training, including product knowledge, buyer personas, competition, tools training, and plenty of role-plays

  • Provide BDRs with a coaching cadence of time management, objection handling, prospecting tactics, and active listening skills

  • Strategize with sales and marketing counterparts on pipeline and prospecting initiatives to meet company objectives

  • Review and maintain metrics to ensure accurate management reports

  • Analyze Outreach cadences with an eye towards continual improvement and up-to-date messaging, by buyer persona and by industry

  • Work closely with marketing, and sales to ensure the BDR onboarding program and ongoing training is up-to-date and best-in-class Partner with sales and marketing operations to ensure the BDR team has the best tools to do their job, and that they are configured to ensure BDR efficiency and productivity, especially Salesforce, and Outreach

  • Ensure sales accepted opportunities are sourced in accordance with company targets, and that our Account Executives have enough opportunities to work with to be fully productive

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Previous work experience managing successful inbound and outbound BDR teams

  • Ability to understand technical concepts, possess enthusiasm for technology and to articulate clearly to all levels of technical aptitude

  • Ability to adapt quickly to a fast-paced environment

  • Proven work experience as a Business Development Manager, Sales Account Executive or Sales Management Role

  • Hands-on experience with multiple sales techniques (including cold calls)

  • Track record of achieving sales quotas

  • Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce)

  • Familiarity with MS Excel and/ or Google Suite (analyzing spreadsheets and charts)

  • Understanding of sales performance metrics

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills

  • Ability to deliver engaging presentations

  • BS degree in Marketing, Business Administration or relevant field or equivalent military experience required

Additional Information

The Team

We work hand-in-hand with organizations around the world as they move to a more secure environment. As Manager of the Business Development team, you find and create opportunities, forming relationships with organizations seeking a trusted partner.

You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, including constantly updated research and sales libraries and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

description:

Responsabilidades:

É responsável pelo no controle e redução dos custos de transporte e despesas não previstas, diariamente, acompanha as rotinas da operação de transporte (Fracionado e Dedicado/Lotação), atende as demandas de contratação e agendamento de veículos vindas do departamento de Customer Service , Fábrica e Clientes, contatando transportadores homologados para cotar, negociar e contratar transporte rodoviário, cabotagem e ferroviário. Juntamente com os times de atendimento ao cliente, comercial e operações analisa as demandas de transporte diário e trabalha na otimização logística de rotas, redução de tarifas e maximização da ocupação de veículos, visando o melhor atendimento das entregas de acordo com os agendamentos ou exigência dos clientes. Tem interface direta com o time de Operações dos centros de distribuição, fábricas e fornecedores, para garantir os horários de chegada e saída dos veículos, bem como garantir que estão em perfeitas condições de qualidade e segurança. 
  • Gestão do fluxo de entrega: Acompanha o fluxo de entrega door-to-door , controla as interfaces de comunicação das mensagens eletrônicas via EDI (Intercâmbio Eletrônico de Dados), atua de forma ativa na análise e resposta das ocorrências reportadas durante o fluxo de entrega, provendo respostas rápidas e resolvendo problemas para garantir os prazos de entrega e mitigar custos extras 
  • Homologação de novas transportadoras : Imputa e gerencia informações nas ferramentas e softwares ERP e TMS, providencia simulações de custo e performance, promove a homologação de novos transportadores, providenciando documentação cadastral obrigatória, e garante a acuracidade das tabelas de tarifas e taxas cadastras no sistema de gestão TMS e demais plataformas. Solicita e mantem atualizada documentação de cadastro mandatória de transportadoras.
  • Compartilhamento de Informações e desenvolvimento: Responsável pela elaboração, gestão e divulgação de planilhas eletrônicas, visões sistêmicas, dashboards com os indicadores de custo, performance e qualidade do serviço de transporte, prepara relatórios para apoio a decisões do Supervisor e do Gerente de Logística, extraindo informações de diferentes fontes e sistemas. Diariamente participa de reuniões e presta suporte necessário a outros departamentos da empresa. 

Qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo preferencialmente em Logística, Administração ou áreas relacionadas; 
  • Habilidade de negociação e comunicação interpessoal; 
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e demais ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Gestão de tempo e organização são requisitos obrigatórios para essa posição;
  • Inglês nível básico. 

Salário compatível com a função JR + alimentação no local + transporte fretado *(mediante disponibilidade) - o transporte se estende das cidades de Balneário Camboriú à Barra Velha.

title: Consultor de Estratégia e Novos Negócios
description:
Descrição :

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Sobre a área:

A área de Estratégia é responsável pela condução do processo de planejamento estratégico da companhia, desde as análises de mercado, passando pelo mapeamento de tendências setoriais, análises de desemprenho interno da companhia, até a formulação do mapa estratégico da empresa, alinhada com toda a liderança da companhia, e suporte analítico para a execução de projetos estratégicos definidos no ciclo anual de planejamento.

O Consultor de Estratégia é responsável pela liderança do time de analistas responsável pela condução das análises, pela consolidação dos temas relevantes e recomendações estratégicas, pela condução do processo de mapeamento da visão da liderança da companhia, pela conexão dos temas estratégicos com o planejamento financeiro da empresa e pelo desdobramento dos projetos estratégicos junto ao time de PMO e líderes de projetos.

Principais atividades:

- Estudos de mercado (Market scan, benchmarks, avaliação de modelos existentes, mapeamento de tendências)

- Avaliação de modelos de entrada em novos mercados e do racional estratégico

- Análise de desempenho interno da companhia e concorrentes (análises financeiras, análise de market share, satisfação de cliente, etc.)

- Condução do mapeamento da visão estratégica da liderança (condução de entrevistas e pesquisas)

- Elaborar recomendações de caminhos estratégicos com base nas visões interna e externa

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

• Formação: Ensino Superior Completo

• Informática: Excel e Power Point Avançado

• Conhecimentos em estratégia e finanças.

• Experiência prévia em áreas de estratégia ou consultoria estratégica

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido - Sede Administrativa Brooklin

Carga Horária: 220h mensal

Escala: segunda a sexta-feira

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00 às 17:48

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Seguro de vida.

Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.

Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

  • Gestão de indicadores: Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho, elaborando relatórios periódicos para a diretoria com foco em resultados e ações de melhorias;

  • Experiência prévia em funções de gestão de pessoas preferencialmente em vendas ou áreas comerciais no mercado imobiliário;
  • Possuir conhecimentos: Recrutamento & Seleção, Treinamento e Desenvolvimento de Equipes;

  • Excelentes habilidades de Comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $4,500 - $5,500 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to lead the design, architecture, and development of their backend systems powering web and serverless applications. You will be responsible for ensuring reliability, scalability, and maintainability across APIs, serverless functions, and databases. You will mentor team members, drive technical decisions, and collaborate closely with frontend, DevOps, and Product teams.

Their backend stack includes Python, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL (RDS), and integrations with React/Amplify frontends.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead backend architecture decisions and define patterns for serverless services.
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable APIs (REST or GraphQL) for web and mobile clients.
  • Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
  • Build and maintain efficient data models and optimized queries in PostgreSQL (RDS).
  • Design serverless workflows leveraging AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SNS/SQS, and EventBridge.
  • Implement robust security, authentication, and authorization mechanisms (Cognito, IAM, OAuth/OIDC).
  • Ensure observability and reliability through monitoring, logging, and automated alerting (CloudWatch, X-Ray, DataDog).
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to ensure APIs meet product requirements and performance expectations.
  • Lead post-mortems, RCA (root cause analysis), and process improvements following incidents.
  • Advocate for best practices in code quality, testing, documentation, and deployment processes.
  • Identify and reduce technical debt while improving system performance and scalability.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development or software engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and backend frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS (PostgreSQL), and serverless architectures.
  • Deep understanding of relational database design, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization (Cognito, OAuth, IAM).
  • Proven experience leading engineering initiatives, mentoring engineers, and making architecture decisions.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and Git workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex distributed systems.
  • Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AWS Amplify for full-stack serverless applications.
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, EventBridge).
  • Experience with caching, queuing, and background processing strategies.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (X-Ray, CloudWatch, DataDog, Sentry).
  • Exposure to frontend technologies (React, TypeScript) for better API integration.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform).
  • Prior experience scaling serverless architectures for high-traffic applications.

Success Indicators:

  • Backend systems are highly reliable, maintainable, and performant.
  • APIs meet frontend and business requirements with minimal defects.
  • Incidents are resolved efficiently, and RCAs drive lasting improvements.
  • Junior/mid-level engineers are mentored effectively and grow in their roles.
  • Technical decisions enhance scalability, security, and developer productivity.

Tools You May Use:

  • Languages & Frameworks:  Python, Flask, FastAPI, Django
  • AWS Services:  Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS (PostgreSQL), Cognito, CloudWatch, X-Ray, EventBridge, SNS/SQS
  • Databases & Caching:  PostgreSQL, Redis (optional)
  • Version Control & CI/CD:  GitHub/GitLab, CI/CD pipelines
  • Observability:  NewRelic, Sentry
  • Frontend Collaboration:  React, Amplify

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a forward-thinking company transforming the future of film and television production through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

Work Schedule:  US Pacific Standard Time

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Lead Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Developer

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved web applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients. You will work with clients, product managers, architects, software engineers, and more to plan, design, develop, test, and implement impactful solutions that support companies with one to millions of employees.

You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code. Every three weeks, you will be involved in the release activities.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.

To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:

  • Strong Java developer with REST API, spring and Spring-boot development experience;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in writing JUNITs for coverage;
  • Experience writing SQL queries and understanding ORM;
  • Good understanding of Jenkins pipelines and CI/CD process;
  • Nice to have experience working with Terraform as IaaC;
  • Advanced English;

As a Lead Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.

Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.

Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.

Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.

Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.

Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.

Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.

Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

Together with its sister companies Swarovski Optik (optical devices) and Tyrolit (abrasives), Swarovski Crystal Business forms the Swarovski Group. A responsible relationship with people and the planet is part of Swarovski’s heritage. Today this legacy is rooted in sustainability measures across the value chain, with an emphasis on circular innovation, championing diversity, inclusion and self-expression, and in the philanthropic work of the Swarovski Foundation, which supports charitable organizations bringing positive environmental and social impact.

title: Creative Copywriter
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please, submit your CV in English.

Portfolio Requirement: Must include campaign concepts, slogans, scripts, and cross-platform copywriting samples .

About the Role

We’re seeking a mid-level Creative Copywriter to craft compelling narratives and high-converting copy for our brand in Brazil. You’ll create promotional campaigns while ensuring brand consistency across TV, digital, and social media. A strong portfolio showcasing conceptual thinking and linguistic creativity is essential. Familiarity with advertising trends is a key differentiator.

Key Responsibilities

Copywriting & Conceptual Development

  • Write original, high-impact copy for ads (TV, digital, social), slogans, and video scripts (e.g., promos, brand films).
  • Develop campaign concepts aligned with marketing goals, from brainstorming to execution.
  • Adapt global brand messaging for the Brazilian market , ensuring cultural resonance.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with designers, videomakers, and marketers to turn ideas into polished deliverables.
  • Present creative strategies and messaging recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Ensure brand voice consistency across all touchpoints (e.g., product descriptions, social posts).

Creative Problem-Solving

  • Tackle challenges with original, data-informed solutions (e.g., A/B testing copy variants).
  • Stay updated on advertising trends (e.g., TikTok hooks, influencer scripts) and apply insights.
  • Manage concurrent projects with tight deadlines (e.g., seasonal campaigns, flash sales).

Job Requirements

  • Experience as a Creative Copywriter (agency, in-house, or freelance).

Portfolio showcasing:

  • Conceptual campaigns (e.g., full-funnel copy for promos, brand storytelling).
  • Video scripts (TV commercials, digital ads) and slogans .
  • Adaptability across tones (e.g., humorous, emotional, direct response).
  • Advanced English (for localization and global collaboration).
  • Degree in Journalism, Advertising, Marketing, or Communications .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of visual storytelling (e.g., storyboarding, collaboration with designers).
  • Familiarity with SEO/ASO basics and performance-driven copywriting .

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

iMerit Scholars is rapidly expanding our network of skilled AI Evaluation Analysts to help advance next-generation multimodal AI systems.

Why Join iMerit Scholars

  • Help shape how cutting-edge AI systems understand the world

Next Steps

O projeto envolve o estudo cromatográfico de extratos naturais, o desenvolvimento e aplicação de métodos para identificação e quantificação de compostos fitoquímicos, além da proposição e validação de metodologias analíticas que ampliem a precisão e a confiabilidade dos processos laboratoriais.

O objetivo é consolidar práticas robustas, documentadas e replicáveis, fortalecendo a base científica por trás dos futuros ingredientes naturais da empresa.

Se você deseja contribuir para soluções que conectam ciência, inovação e sustentabilidade, impulsionando a criação de ingredientes exclusivos e reforçando o posicionamento inovador do Grupo Boticário, essa oportunidade é para você.

.

  • Levantamento bibliográfico de metodologias analíticas e compostos fitoquímicos descritos na literatura.
  • Estudo e aplicação de técnicas analíticas para caracterização de extratos naturais.
  • Execução de experimentos de caracterização cromatográfica, incluindo:
  • Cromatografia líquida: LC-DAD , LC-MS , LC-FLR .
  • Cromatografia gasosa: GC-FID , GC-MS .
  • Screening de tecnologias para caracterização de diferentes ativos vegetais.
  • Preparo de amostras e execução de experimentos analíticos.
  • Avaliação aprofundada da composição fitoquímica de ativos vegetais por meio de técnicas avançadas.
  • Apoio no desenvolvimento de metodologias cromatográficas preparativas, obtenção de frações enriquecidas e aplicação em produtos naturais.
  • Aplicação de métodos farmacopeicos para identificação e quantificação de produtos naturais.

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Formação em Química, Química Industrial, Farmácia, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Química ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento ou atuação prévia em linhas de pesquisa como: fitoquímica, caracterização fitoquímica, química analítica de produtos naturais, botânica, farmacognosia ou biotecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com preparo de amostras, extração de compostos naturais e execução de análises qualitativas e quantitativas.
  • Capacidade de interpretar dados analíticos complexos e correlacionar composição fitoquímica com propriedades dos extratos.
  • Conhecimento em métodos farmacopeicos para identificação e quantificação de produtos naturais.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento de metodologias analíticas e validação de métodos.

You will collaborate with entrepreneurs, mentors, and other stakeholders to drive innovation, conduct market research, and facilitate fundraising strategies. Additionally, you will contribute to our community initiatives while sharing your expertise in investment and startup ecosystems. Purely capital investments are also welcome for consideration.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Investment Analysis, Portfolio Management, and Valuation
  • Experience with Investing, Fundraising, Capital Structuring, and Financial Modelling
  • Keen understanding of Startup Ecosystems, Business Development, and Strategy
  • Exceptional skills in Communication, Networking, and Building Relationships
  • Familiarity with Technology Trends and Sustainability-driven ventures
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and guide startup teams effectively
  • MUST be AI & Crypto/Blockchain proficient
  • MUST have startup/business experience at the FOUNDING and/or C-levels
  • MUST be a Startup Investor with at least some portfolio companies to speak of
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is indispensable

Compensation will be heavily equity (or equivalent) based and lightly cash based - those purely seeking salaries NEED NOT APPLY

Thank you very much for your consideration! Looking forward to reviewing your application (which MUST be made here AND by contacting with an EMAIL describing your capabilities and desires as relevant to this role)

title: Analista de Credenciamento Sr
description:
Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer soluções completas, que potencializem novos negócios. E estamos ao lado dos nossos clientes na hora em que mais precisam. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.

Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!

O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou estacionamento conveniado;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Gympass e Totalpass;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

No seu dia-a-dia :

  • Atuar nas atividades de pequena, média e alta complexidade para prospectar profissionais médicos, clinicas, através de visitas, apresentando vantagens e propostas de atração, visando o credenciamento para atendimento aos clientes, e aumento da utilização da rede credenciada;
  • Realizar a prospecção, implantação, manutenção e expansão da rede credenciada, analisando custos e garantindo a qualidade do serviço prestado, atuando com autonomia;
  • Descrever o processo de credenciamento de prestadores de serviço de atenção domiciliar, Retaguarda e Atenção Primária à Saúde, bem como elaborar relatórios e demonstrativos diversos da área, levantar e compilar dados, calcular e apurar valores, preenchendo
  • planilhas, visando disponibilizar informações gerenciais para a análise e tomada de decisão. Negociar com os novos credenciamentos a aplicação e padronização e referente as tabelas utilizadas pela companhia;
  • Realizar reuniões com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar para a análise de contratos, reajustes, aditivos de contratos, prestar suporte aos prestadores implantados, bem como orientar os novos prestadores sobre a rotina de faturamento, encaminhamentos e autorizações da operadora;
  • Monitorar o atendimento das cláusulas contratuais e índices da Agência Nacional da Saúde (ANS), através de reuniões para renegociações de reajustes e readequação de contratos;
  • Atender solicitações das Unimeds, direcionar as demandas às áreas pertinentes quando necessário, acompanhar e finalizar as resoluções;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as informações referentes ao negócio, bem como sobre projetos de expansão, legislação, concorrentes, clientes (operadora, médicos, clinicas, operadoras, etc.) e novas oportunidades;
  • Elaborar simulações de impacto financeiro com base nas solicitações de reajuste das Unimeds para renovação contratual;
  • Assessorar a Diretoria, a Superintendência, a Gerência nas demandas de relacionamento com
  • as Unimeds (custos, indicadores, reuniões). Parametrizar sistema interno com as regras contratuais e tabelas de pagamentos negociadas;
  • Manter constante contato com a área comercial, visando conhecer os novos negócios e ampliação dos atuais contratos, atuando proativamente na ampliação da rede de
  • credenciamento;
  • Pesquisar a abertura de novas unidades aos clientes, e/ou novos contratos em andamento e providenciar a rede credenciada necessária para atendimento, bem como manter a interface com a área de credenciamento para auxiliar no processo do credenciamento, e envio da documentação para credenciamento dos prestadores;
  • Verificar e analisar as cidades e municípios circunvizinhos, verificando a capacidade e disponibilidade de credenciamentos, visando o atendimento aos clientes e expansão nos negócios, e a partir desta análise elaborar credenciamento com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar.

Esperamos de você :

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Pacote office intermédiário;
  • Experiência com credenciamento de rede ambulatorial;

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ;
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.

A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Customer Service Agent / Survey
description:
Company Description

Best Servicers of America is an innovative provider of on-site services solutions, dedicated to enhancing brand image and customer service experience. We offer accurate diagnostic and technical support and follow-up phone calls to ensure customer satisfaction. Our team works closely with businesses to tailor our services to meet their unique requirements, dispatching professional technicians to provide total business solutions.

Role Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Billing Specialist to join our Billing Department. This role plays a key part in ensuring accuracy in service repair claims and payments. You will review completed repairs, confirm pricing, submit claims to customers, and verify technician payments. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities are essential, as this position directly impacts financial accuracy and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review completed repair tickets to ensure all prices and charges are correct.
  • Submit claims to customers and follow up to resolve any issues.
  • Verify and process payments for technicians who completed the repairs.
  • Make phone calls in English to technicians, customers, and consumers when clarification or updates are needed.
  • Contact customers to correct claim issues and provide status updates.
  • Collaborate with the billing and operations team to support overall department efficiency.
  • Proactively identify and solve problems to avoid delays in payments or claims processing.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in billing, claims, customer service, or a similar role (preferred but not required).
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to learn quickly and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written).
  • Proactive, problem-solving mindset with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Computer proficiency (MS Office, email, Excel).

Please read before applying:

You will be receiving an email with a DocuSign form to be completed.

Contact me on Skype. At the end of the form, there is a Skype link to contact me to schedule the interview time and date.

Only the candidates who read and complete all the steps will be interviewed.

***RESUMES MUST BE SENT IN ENGLISH ONLY***

We are looking for people who want to grow with us.

The position we have at this moment is in the Logistics Department. 

The job is from Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 or 9:00 to 18:00 (USA Eastern Standard Time). This opportunity is for someone who can work unsupervised and work from home.

The requirements are:

- Having a fast computer (minimum 8 GB of RAM) and a headset with a microphone that you can use to work (no earbuds or AirPods).

- Having high-speed internet (100mbps or faster) access at home.

- Have a quiet environment (no dogs barking, babies crying, loud music, street noises, or similar in the background).

- Two screens to start the training (will ask for pictures before the interview).

The payment is $850.00 US Dollars per month. Paid direct deposit on the 5th of each month.

We have a probationary period of 90 days, during which you will be in training, and during this period you will be receiving $700.00 US Dollars per month.

***Do not apply if your salary expectations exceed this offer, as the salary is not negotiable.

Hiring process:

LinkedIn applications will be reviewed within 48 hours of being sent.

If your profile qualifies, you'll receive an email with a DocuSign form.

Contact us via Skype to schedule the interview (the link will be inside the form)

Seja um #NewPurple na Grant Thornton Brasil!

O que esperar da Grant Thornton?

Valorizamos nossas pessoas e direcionamos todos os nossos esforços para a constante construção de uma cultura organizacional mais diversa e inclusiva. DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

title: Media Public Relations Specialist
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic PR Specialist to lead public relations for our smartphone brand. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping our brand narrative, strengthening media relations, driving product launch coverage, and managing crisis communications. This role requires a strong network with tech and lifestyle media, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver impactful stories that position our brand as an industry leader.

Key Responsibilities:

Public Relations & Media:

  • Develop and execute PR strategies that enhance brand visibility and credibility in the smartphone industry.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier tech, lifestyle, and business media outlets.
  • Draft, review, and distribute press releases, media kits, Q&As, and product-related communications.
  • Secure proactive media coverage across online, print, broadcast, and influencer platforms.

Product Launch Support:

  • Lead PR campaigns for new smartphone launches, from pre-launch buzz to post-launch media engagement.
  • Organize and manage press conferences, launch events, and media briefings.
  • Collaborate with product and marketing teams to craft compelling product stories.

Corporate & Crisis Communication:

  • Act as spokesperson when required; prepare executives for media interviews.
  • Monitor public sentiment and manage crisis communications with timely responses.
  • Ensure consistent alignment with global brand messaging and corporate communication guidelines.

Content & Storytelling:

  • Create thought leadership content, media pitches, and brand stories highlighting innovation, technology, and lifestyle value.
  • Collaborate with social media and digital teams to extend PR campaigns online.

Measurement & Reporting:

  • Track, analyze, and report PR performance metrics (media coverage, SOV, sentiment, reach, etc.).
  • Provide insights and recommendations for improving PR effectiveness.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in PR, preferably in consumer electronics, smartphones, or technology sector.
  • Strong media network across tech, lifestyle, and business press.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills in (insert relevant languages).
  • Experience managing product launch PR campaigns end-to-end.
  • Skilled in crisis communication and reputation management.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global brand environment.
  • Proficiency in PR monitoring and analytics tools.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience working with influencers and KOLs in the tech/lifestyle space.
  • Previous experience in managing agency partners and event PR.
  • Familiarity with mobile technology trends and consumer behavior in emerging markets

Diferenciais

Uma empresa madura, cujas experiências acumuladas permitem diferenciais na sua forma de fazer negócio. No serviço personalizado, no comprometimento e na qualidade. Assim tem sido nossa empresa ao longo dos anos, apoiando seus clientes e destacando-se entre as alternativas de mercado.

Estamos com a seguinte oportunidade em aberto:

Cientista de Dados Sênior (Foco em Estatística e Modelagem)

• Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas correlatas. Pós-graduação (Mestrado/Doutorado) em Estatística, Econometria ou Métodos Quantitativos é um diferencial.

• Estatística Avançada: Domínio de métodos estatísticos, inferência, econometria, amostragem e teste de hipóteses.

• Programação: Proficiência em Python ou R para análise de dados, estatística e desenvolvimento de modelos.

• Bancos de Dados: Experiência com SQL para manipulação e extração de dados.

• Experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados ou em função quantitativa similar.

Atividades da função:

• Modelagem Estatística: Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos estatísticos (regressão, séries temporais, modelos lineares generalizados, etc.) e algoritmos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio complexos.

• Análise Preditiva e Prescritiva: Liderar análises aprofundadas usando técnicas estatísticas para previsão de tendências, segmentação de clientes, otimização de processos e avaliação de risco.

• Teste de Hipóteses e Experimentação (A/B Testing): Conduzir o design de experimentos (DOE) e realizar testes A/B rigorosos, aplicando testes de significância estatística para medir o impacto e a eficácia de novas funcionalidades ou estratégias.

• Validação e Interpretabilidade: Garantir a validade estatística dos modelos e resultados, focando na interpretabilidade para que as descobertas sejam claramente comunicadas e acionáveis para as equipes de produto e executivas.

• Manipulação e Limpeza de Dados: Trabalhar com big data, realizar ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas análises.

• Comunicação de Insights: Traduzir resultados estatísticos complexos em narrativas de negócio claras, utilizando visualizações de dados eficazes e relatórios detalhados para stakeholders não-técnicos.

Excelente oportunidade!

Presencial na região da Vila Mariana em São Paulo/SP.

Contratação direta pelo cliente!

title: Contatóloga(o)
description:
Vision One é uma empresa que cuida da saúde ocular do paciente em todas as etapas da sua jornada.

Somos uma rede nacional que integra hospitais e clínicas especializadas em oftalmologia, unidades ópticas e um robusto Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC), oferecendo excelência médica, soluções personalizadas e gestão eficiente.

Nascemos do desejo genuíno de médicos e fundadores dos mais respeitados hospitais de olhos do país de construir uma empresa forte, líder e inspiradora, com foco em qualidade, humanização, valorização médica e os mais altos padrões de cuidado.

Com atuação integrada e visão de longo prazo, a Vision One promove saúde ocular com responsabilidade, inovação e compromisso com o bem-estar dos pacientes.

E o que move nossa cultura é o CUIDAR .

C orretos

U nidos

I nclusivos

D edicados

Á geis

R esolutivos

Somos um time em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá muitos desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará em nosso Centro de Adaptação de Lentes de Contato , ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial.

- Atendimento ao Paciente; adaptação de Lentes de Contato e relacionamento médico;

- Registrar, em prontuário, os testes realizados e lentes adaptadas;

- Encomendar as lentes com os fornecedores;

- Registrar as Lentes utilizadas no serviço de adaptação, na conta paciente, para controle de saída de estoque;

· Seguro de vida

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner plays a key role in driving hiring success across Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams in the LATAM region. This role operates within client’s global Talent Acquisition organization and partners closely with business leaders to develop and execute effective hiring strategies.

It requires a high level of autonomy, strong stakeholder management, and a consultative approach to ensure high-quality, timely hires in a competitive market. The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner helps shape hiring plans, advise on talent trends, and champion client’s growth across LATAM.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment across Engineering, Product, and GTM roles in the LATAM region — from intake through offer.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and senior leaders to define needs, build strategies, and drive hiring outcomes.
  • Use tools like LinkedIn Recruiter to proactively source top talent and build diverse pipelines.
  • Translate market research into actionable hiring strategies, including competitor insights, compensation trends, and talent availability.
  • Own the candidate experience, ensuring timely communication, smooth process flow, and alignment with client’s brand.
  • Leverage AI tools and recruiting technology to enhance speed, quality, and efficiency throughout the hiring lifecycle.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, including interview process design, DEI initiatives, and talent analytics.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5–10 years of professional experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally across technical and go-to-market roles.
  • Proven success recruiting in the LATAM region, with a strong understanding of local talent markets.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish; able to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.
  • Skilled in sourcing and candidate engagement using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple roles with competing priorities.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders on hiring decisions, market insights, and strategy.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; Workday experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI tools and technology into recruiting workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Portuguese language proficiency.
  • Prior recruiting experience within SaaS or high-growth product companies.
  • Familiarity with Workday or similar enterprise-level ATS platforms.

title: HDP Administrator / Architect
description:
Role Summary

The HDP Administrator / Architect will provide deep technical expertise in administering and modernizing Hortonworks (HDP) and Cloudera environments as part of enterprise-scale data modernization initiatives powered by NexusOne . This role is responsible for ensuring operational stability, performance, and compliance of existing Hadoop environments, while architecting and supporting the transition toward open-source, cloud-native components (e.g., Spark, Iceberg, Trino, Ranger, DataHub).

This individual must possess hands-on depth in the full Hortonworks stack — from cluster management and security to performance tuning and metadata governance — serving as the technical bridge between legacy and modern data ecosystems.

Core Responsibilities

  • Administer, monitor, and optimize Hortonworks Data Platform (HDP) clusters, including HDFS, YARN, Hive, HBase, Oozie, Ranger, Atlas, and Ambari.
  • Perform environment maintenance and upgrades — patching, version management, capacity planning, and backup/recovery.
  • Ensure platform reliability, high availability, and adherence to enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Platform Architecture teams to design migration strategies from HDP/Cloudera to modern open-source frameworks.
  • Lead the migration of data, metadata, and security policies from legacy components (e.g., Atlas/Ranger) to DataHub, Iceberg , and modern equivalents.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and resolve complex performance or stability issues across distributed systems.
  • Implement and maintain Kerberos, LDAP/SSO integration, and role-based access control (RBAC) policies.
  • Document architecture, configurations, and operational runbooks for cluster management and decommissioning.
  • Train and mentor engineers in HDP administration, troubleshooting, and modernization best practices.

Must-Have Core Skills

  • Deep Hortonworks Expertise: Proven hands-on administration experience with HDP 2.x / 3.x , including HDFS, YARN, Hive, HBase, Oozie, Ranger, Atlas, Ambari, and Kerberos.
  • Cloudera Stack Knowledge: Understanding of Cloudera Manager and CDP transition paths.
  • Security & Governance: Expertise in configuring and managing Ranger, Atlas, Kerberos, LDAP/SSO , and encryption frameworks.
  • Performance Optimization: Skilled in resource tuning, query optimization, and capacity planning for large-scale clusters.
  • Automation & Infrastructure: Experience with Ansible, Terraform , or equivalent for provisioning and configuration management.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on with Grafana, Prometheus, Ambari Metrics , or equivalent platforms.
  • Scripting & OS: Strong Linux administration and scripting (Bash, Python).

Ideal Background

  • 5–10 years of experience as an HDP or Cloudera Administrator supporting production-grade clusters at scale.
  • Deep operational experience with Hortonworks Data Platform (HDP) , including upgrades, troubleshooting, and tuning.
  • Prior involvement in data platform modernization or cloud migration programs .
  • Knowledge of emerging open-source frameworks (Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub).
  • Proven ability to collaborate across platform, security, and data teams to deliver mission-critical outcomes.

Success Criteria

  • Sustained platform stability and high availability throughout modernization.
  • Successful migration of data, metadata, and policies to NexusOne-aligned open-source components.
  • Zero major incidents or regressions during transition or decommissioning.
  • Clear documentation and knowledge transfer to engineering and operations teams.
  • Recognition as a subject-matter expert in Hortonworks administration and modernization best practices .

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM RELAÇÕES TRABALHISTA

Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas , no Pará.

Nosso jeito de fazer mineração é guiado por valores sólidos: cuidado, coragem, honestidade, colaboração e excelência . Esses princípios estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos — desde o chão da mina até as decisões estratégicas. E eles também orientam como cuidamos do crescimento de cada pessoa na ERO .

O nosso objetivo é claro: ser a melhor empresa de mineração do Brasil, e sabemos que isso só é possível investindo nas pessoas que constroem esse futuro com a gente, todos os dias.

Se identificou?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Especialista de Relações Trabalhistas que será responsável por assegurar relações trabalhistas sólidas e sustentáveis, apoiando a gestão em temas legais e negociais, prevenindo riscos e fortalecendo o relacionamento institucional com entidades representativas.
